speaker: god
text: I have raised children and brought them up, but they have rebelled against Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The ox knows its owner, and the donkey its master’s manger, but Israel does not know; My people do not understand.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: What good to Me is your multitude of sacrifices?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I am full from the burnt offerings of rams and the fat of well-fed cattle; I take no delight in the blood of bulls and lambs and goats.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: When you come to appear before Me, who has required this of you— this trampling of My courts?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Bring your worthless offerings no more; your incense is detestable to Me— your New Moons, Sabbaths, and convocations. I cannot endure iniquity in a solemn assembly.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I hate your New Moons and your appointed feasts. They have become a burden to Me; I am weary of bearing them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: When you spread out your hands in prayer, I will hide My eyes from you; even though you multiply your prayers, I will not listen. Your hands are covered with blood.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Wash and cleanse yourselves. Remove your evil deeds from My sight. Stop doing evil!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Learn to do right; seek justice and correct the oppressor. Defend the fatherless and plead the case of the widow.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Come now, let us reason together,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Though your sins are like scarlet, they will be as white as snow; though they are as red as crimson, they will become like wool.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the best of the land.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But if you resist and rebel, you will be devoured by the sword.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Ah, I will be relieved of My foes and avenge Myself on My enemies.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will turn My hand against you; I will thoroughly purge your dross; I will remove all your impurities.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will restore your judges as at first, and your counselors as at the beginning. After that you will be called the City of Righteousness, the Faithful City.
name: The LORD

speaker: peoples
text: Come, let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob. He will teach us His ways so that we may walk in His paths.
name: The peoples

speaker: god
text: I will make mere lads their leaders, and children will rule over them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You have devoured the vineyard; the plunder of the poor is in your houses.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Why do you crush My people and grind the faces of the poor?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Because the daughters of Zion are haughty— walking with heads held high and wanton eyes, prancing and skipping as they go, jingling the bracelets on their ankles—
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: the Lord will bring sores on the heads of the daughters of Zion, and the LORD will make their foreheads bare.
name: The LORD

speaker: seven-women
text: We will eat our own bread and provide our own clothes. Just let us be called by your name. Take away our disgrace!
name: Seven women

speaker: god
text: And now, O dwellers of Jerusalem and men of Judah, I exhort you to judge between Me and My vineyard.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: What more could I have done for My vineyard than I already did for it? Why, when I expected sweet grapes, did it bring forth sour fruit?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Now I will tell you what I am about to do to My vineyard: I will take away its hedge, and it will be consumed; I will tear down its wall, and it will be trampled.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will make it a wasteland, neither pruned nor cultivated, and thorns and briers will grow up. I will command the clouds that rain shall not fall on it.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Surely many houses will become desolate, great mansions left unoccupied.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For ten acres of vineyard will yield but a bath of wine, and a homer of seed only an ephah of grain.
name: The LORD

speaker: scoffers
text: Let Him hurry and hasten His work so that we may see it! Let the plan of the Holy One of Israel come so that we may know it!
name: The scoffers

speaker: seraphim
text: Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of Hosts; all the earth is full of His glory.
name: The seraphim

speaker: isaiah
text: Woe is me, for I am ruined, because I am a man of unclean lips dwelling among a people of unclean lips; for my eyes have seen the King, the LORD of Hosts.
name: Isaiah

speaker: seraphim
text: Now that this has touched your lips, your iniquity is removed and your sin is atoned for.
name: The seraphim

speaker: god
text: Whom shall I send? Who will go for Us?
name: The LORD

speaker: isaiah
text: Here am I. Send me!
name: Isaiah

speaker: god
text: Go and tell this people, ‘Be ever hearing, but never understanding; be ever seeing, but never perceiving.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Make the hearts of this people calloused; deafen their ears and close their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts, and turn and be healed.
name: The LORD

speaker: isaiah
text: How long, O Lord?
name: Isaiah

speaker: god
text: Until the cities lie ruined and without inhabitant, until the houses are left unoccupied and the land is desolate and ravaged,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: until the LORD has driven men far away and the land is utterly forsaken.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And though a tenth remains in the land, it will be burned again. As the terebinth and oak leave stumps when felled, so the holy seed will be a stump in the land.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Go out with your son Shear-jashub to meet Ahaz at the end of the aqueduct that feeds the upper pool, on the road to the Launderer’s Field,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: and say to him: Calm down and be quiet. Do not be afraid or disheartened over these two smoldering stubs of firewood—over the fierce anger of Rezin and Aram and of the son of Remaliah.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For Aram, along with Ephraim and the son of Remaliah, has plotted your ruin, saying:
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: ‘Let us invade Judah, terrorize it, and divide it among ourselves. Then we can install the son of Tabeal over it as king.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘It will not arise; it will not happen.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For the head of Aram is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin. Within sixty-five years Ephraim will be shattered as a people.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is the son of Remaliah. If you do not stand firm in your faith, then you will not stand at all.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Ask for a sign from the LORD your God, whether from the depths of Sheol or the heights of heaven.
name: The LORD

speaker: ahaz
text: I will not ask; I will not test the LORD.
name: Ahaz

speaker: isaiah
text: Hear now, O house of David! Is it not enough to try the patience of men? Will you try the patience of my God as well?
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: Therefore the Lord Himself will give you a sign: Behold, the virgin will be with child and will give birth to a son, and will call Him Immanuel.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: By the time He knows enough to reject evil and choose good, He will be eating curds and honey.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: For before the boy knows enough to reject evil and choose good, the land of the two kings you dread will be laid waste.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: The LORD will bring on you and on your people and on the house of your father a time unlike any since the day Ephraim separated from Judah—He will bring the king of Assyria.
name: Isaiah

speaker: god
text: Take a large scroll and write on it with an ordinary stylus: Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And I will appoint for Myself trustworthy witnesses—Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberekiah.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Name him Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For before the boy knows how to cry ‘Father’ or ‘Mother,’ the wealth of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried off by the king of Assyria.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Because this people has rejected the gently flowing waters of Shiloah and rejoiced in Rezin and the son of Remaliah,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: the Lord will surely bring against them the mighty floodwaters of the Euphrates— the king of Assyria and all his pomp. It will overflow its channels and overrun its banks.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: It will pour into Judah, swirling and sweeping over it, reaching up to the neck; its spreading streams will cover your entire land, O Immanuel!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Huddle together, O peoples, and be shattered; pay attention, all you distant lands; prepare for battle, and be shattered; prepare for battle, and be shattered!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Devise a plan, but it will be thwarted; state a proposal, but it will not happen. For God is with us.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do not call conspiracy everything these people regard as conspiracy. Do not fear what they fear; do not live in dread.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The LORD of Hosts is the One you shall regard as holy. Only He should be feared; only He should be dreaded.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And He will be a sanctuary— but to both houses of Israel a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense, to the dwellers of Jerusalem a trap and a snare.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Many will stumble over these; they will fall and be broken; they will be ensnared and captured.
name: The LORD

speaker: israelites
text: The bricks have fallen, but we will rebuild with finished stone; the sycamores have been felled, but we will replace them with cedars.
name: The people of Israel

speaker: assyria-king
text: Are not all my commanders kings?
name: The king of Assyria

speaker: assyria-king
text: Is not Calno like Carchemish? Is not Hamath like Arpad? Is not Samaria like Damascus?
name: The king of Assyria

speaker: assyria-king
text: As my hand seized the idolatrous kingdoms whose images surpassed those of Jerusalem and Samaria,
name: The king of Assyria

speaker: assyria-king
text: and as I have done to Samaria and its idols, will I not also do to Jerusalem and her idols?
name: The king of Assyria

speaker: god
text: I will punish the king of Assyria for the fruit of his arrogant heart and the proud look in his eyes.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For he says: ‘By the strength of my hand I have done this, and by my wisdom, for I am clever. I have removed the boundaries of nations and plundered their treasures; like a mighty one I subdued their rulers.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: My hand reached as into a nest to seize the wealth of the nations. Like one gathering abandoned eggs, I gathered all the earth. No wing fluttered, no beak opened or chirped.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: O My people who dwell in Zion, do not fear Assyria, who strikes you with a rod and lifts his staff against you as the Egyptians did.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For in just a little while My fury against you will subside, and My anger will turn to their destruction.
name: The LORD

speaker: assyria-king
text: We will spend the night at Geba.
name: The king of Assyria

speaker: worshipers
text: O LORD, I will praise You. Although You were angry with me, Your anger has turned away, and You have comforted me.
name: The redeemed

speaker: worshipers
text: Surely God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid. For the LORD GOD is my strength and my song, and He also has become my salvation.
name: The redeemed

speaker: worshipers
text: Give praise to the LORD; proclaim His name! Make His works known among the peoples; declare that His name is exalted.
name: The redeemed

speaker: worshipers
text: Sing to the LORD, for He has done glorious things. Let this be known in all the earth.
name: The redeemed

speaker: worshipers
text: Cry out and sing, O citizen of Zion, for great among you is the Holy One of Israel.
name: The redeemed

speaker: shades
text: You too have become weak, as we are; you have become like us!
name: The dead in Sheol

speaker: king-of-babylon
text: I will ascend to the heavens; I will raise my throne above the stars of God. I will sit on the mount of assembly, in the far reaches of the north.
name: The king of Babylon

speaker: king-of-babylon
text: I will ascend above the tops of the clouds; I will make myself like the Most High.
name: The king of Babylon

speaker: onlookers
text: Is this the man who shook the earth and made the kingdoms tremble,
name: Those who see him

speaker: onlookers
text: who turned the world into a desert and destroyed its cities, who refused to let the captives return to their homes?
name: Those who see him

speaker: god
text: I will rise up against them,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will cut off from Babylon her name and her remnant, her offspring and her posterity,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will make her a place for owls and for swamplands; I will sweep her away with the broom of destruction,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Surely, as I have planned, so will it be; as I have purposed, so will it stand.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will break Assyria in My land; I will trample him on My mountain. His yoke will be taken off My people, and his burden removed from their shoulders.
name: The LORD

speaker: moab
text: Give us counsel; render a decision. Shelter us at noonday with shade as dark as night. Hide the refugees; do not betray the one who flees.
name: The daughters of Moab

speaker: moab
text: Let my fugitives stay with you; be a refuge for Moab from the destroyer.
name: The daughters of Moab

speaker: god
text: In three years, as a hired worker counts the years, Moab’s splendor will become an object of contempt, with all her many people. And those who are left will be few and feeble.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, Damascus is no longer a city; it has become a heap of ruins.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The cities of Aroer are forsaken; they will be left to the flocks, which will lie down with no one to fear.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The fortress will disappear from Ephraim, and the sovereignty from Damascus. The remnant of Aram will be like the splendor of the Israelites,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In that day the splendor of Jacob will fade, and the fat of his body will waste away,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: as the reaper gathers the standing grain and harvests the ears with his arm, as one gleans heads of grain in the Valley of Rephaim.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yet gleanings will remain, like an olive tree that has been beaten— two or three berries atop the tree, four or five on its fruitful branches,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will quietly look on from My dwelling place, like shimmering heat in the sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So I will incite Egyptian against Egyptian; brother will fight against brother, neighbor against neighbor, city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then the spirit of the Egyptians will be emptied out from among them, and I will frustrate their plans, so that they will resort to idols and spirits of the dead, to mediums and spiritists.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will deliver the Egyptians into the hands of harsh masters, and a fierce king will rule over them,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Blessed be Egypt My people, Assyria My handiwork, and Israel My inheritance.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Go, remove the sackcloth from your waist and the sandals from your feet.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Just as My servant Isaiah has gone naked and barefoot for three years as a sign and omen against Egypt and Cush,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: so the king of Assyria will lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Cush, young and old alike, naked and barefoot, with bared buttocks—to Egypt’s shame.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Those who made Cush their hope and Egypt their boast will be dismayed and ashamed.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And on that day the dwellers of this coastland will say, ‘See what has happened to our source of hope, those to whom we fled for help and deliverance from the king of Assyria! How then can we escape?’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The traitor still betrays, and the destroyer still destroys. Go up, O Elam! Lay siege, O Media! I will put an end to all her groaning.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Go, post a lookout and have him report what he sees.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: When he sees chariots with teams of horsemen, riders on donkeys, riders on camels, he must be alert, fully alert.
name: The LORD

speaker: lookout
text: Day after day, my lord, I stand on the watchtower; night after night I stay at my post.
name: The lookout

speaker: lookout
text: Look, here come the riders, horsemen in pairs.
name: The lookout

speaker: one-from-seir
text: Watchman, what is left of the night? Watchman, what is left of the night?
name: One from Seir

speaker: watchman
text: Morning has come, but also the night. If you would inquire, then inquire. Come back yet again.
name: The watchman

speaker: god
text: Within one year, as a hired worker would count it, all the glory of Kedar will be gone.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The remaining archers, the warriors of Kedar, will be few.
name: The LORD

speaker: isaiah
text: Turn away from me, let me weep bitterly! Do not try to console me over the destruction of the daughter of my people.
name: Isaiah

speaker: revelers
text: Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die!
name: The revelers

speaker: god
text: Until your dying day, this sin of yours will never be atoned for,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Go, say to Shebna, the steward in charge of the palace:
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: What are you doing here, and who authorized you to carve out a tomb for yourself here—to chisel your tomb in the height and cut your resting place in the rock?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Look, O mighty man! The LORD is about to shake you violently. He will take hold of you,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: roll you into a ball, and sling you into a wide land. There you will die, and there your glorious chariots will remain—a disgrace to the house of your master.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will remove you from office, and you will be ousted from your position.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: On that day I will summon My servant, Eliakim son of Hilkiah.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will clothe him with your robe and tie your sash around him. I will put your authority in his hand, and he will be a father to the dwellers of Jerusalem and to the house of Judah.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will place on his shoulder the key to the house of David. What he opens no one can shut, and what he shuts no one can open.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will drive him like a peg into a firm place, and he will be a throne of glory for the house of his father.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So they will hang on him all the glory of his father’s house: the descendants and the offshoots—all the lesser vessels, from bowls to every kind of jar.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In that day, declares the LORD of Hosts, the peg driven into a firm place will give way; it will be sheared off and fall, and the load upon it will be cut down.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You shall rejoice no more, O oppressed Virgin Daughter of Sidon. Get up and cross over to Cyprus— even there you will find no rest.
name: The LORD

speaker: worshipers
text: Glory to the Righteous One.
name: The redeemed

speaker: isaiah
text: I am wasting away! I am wasting away! Woe is me.
name: Isaiah

speaker: worshipers
text: Surely this is our God; we have waited for Him, and He has saved us. This is the LORD for whom we have waited. Let us rejoice and be glad in His salvation.
name: The redeemed

speaker: god
text: Sing about a fruitful vineyard.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I, the LORD, am its keeper; I water it continually. I guard it night and day so no one can disturb it;
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I am not angry. If only thorns and briers confronted Me, I would march and trample them, I would burn them to the ground.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Or let them lay claim to My protection; let them make peace with Me— yes, let them make peace with Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This is the place of rest, let the weary rest; this is the place of repose.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Order on order, order on order, line on line, line on line; a little here, a little there,
name: The LORD

speaker: scoffers
text: We have made a covenant with death; we have fashioned an agreement with Sheol. When the overwhelming scourge passes through it will not touch us, because we have made lies our refuge and falsehood our hiding place.
name: The scoffers

speaker: god
text: See, I lay a stone in Zion, a tested stone, a precious cornerstone, a sure foundation; the one who believes will never be shaken.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will make justice the measuring line and righteousness the level. Hail will sweep away your refuge of lies, and water will flood your hiding place.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Your covenant with death will be dissolved, and your agreement with Sheol will not stand. When the overwhelming scourge passes through, you will be trampled by it.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: As often as it passes through, it will carry you away; it will sweep through morning after morning, by day and by night.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: These people draw near to Me with their mouths and honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me. Their worship of Me is but rules taught by men.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore I will again confound these people with wonder upon wonder. The wisdom of the wise will vanish, and the intelligence of the intelligent will be hidden.
name: The LORD

speaker: scoffers
text: Who sees us, and who will know?
name: The scoffers

speaker: god
text: No longer will Jacob be ashamed and no more will his face grow pale.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For when he sees his children around him, the work of My hands, they will honor My name, they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and they will stand in awe of the God of Israel.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then the wayward in spirit will come to understanding, and those who grumble will accept instruction.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Woe to the rebellious children,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: to those who carry out a plan that is not Mine, who form an alliance, but against My will, heaping up sin upon sin.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They set out to go down to Egypt without asking My advice, to seek shelter under Pharaoh’s protection and take refuge in Egypt’s shade.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But Pharaoh’s protection will become your shame, and the refuge of Egypt’s shade your disgrace.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For though their princes are at Zoan and their envoys have arrived in Hanes,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: everyone will be put to shame because of a people useless to them. They cannot be of help; they are good for nothing but shame and reproach.
name: The LORD

speaker: israelites
text: Stop seeing visions!
name: The people of Israel

speaker: israelites
text: Do not prophesy to us the truth! Speak to us pleasant words; prophesy illusions.
name: The people of Israel

speaker: israelites
text: Get out of the way; turn off the road. Rid us of the Holy One of Israel!
name: The people of Israel

speaker: god
text: Because you have rejected this message, trusting in oppression and relying on deceit,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: this iniquity of yours is like a breach about to fail, a bulge in a high wall, whose collapse will come suddenly— in an instant!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: It will break in pieces like a potter’s jar, shattered so that no fragment can be found. Not a shard will be found in the dust large enough to scoop the coals from a hearth or to skim the water from a cistern.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: By repentance and rest you would be saved; your strength would lie in quiet confidence— but you were not willing.
name: The LORD

speaker: israelites
text: No,
name: The people of Israel

speaker: israelites
text: we will flee on horses.
name: The people of Israel

speaker: israelites
text: We will ride swift horses,
name: The people of Israel

speaker: god
text: This is the way. Walk in it.
name: The LORD

speaker: israelites
text: Be gone!
name: The people of Israel

speaker: god
text: Like a lion roaring or a young lion over its prey— and though a band of shepherds is called out against it, it is not terrified by their shouting or subdued by their clamor— so the LORD of Hosts will come down to do battle on Mount Zion and its heights.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Like birds hovering overhead, so the LORD of Hosts will protect Jerusalem. He will shield it and deliver it; He will pass over it and preserve it.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then Assyria will fall, but not by the sword of man; a sword will devour them, but not one made by mortals. They will flee before the sword, and their young men will be put to forced labor.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Their rock will pass away for fear, and their princes will panic at the sight of the battle standard,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Now I will arise,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Now I will lift Myself up. Now I will be exalted.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You conceive chaff; you give birth to stubble. Your breath is a fire that will consume you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The peoples will be burned to ashes, like thorns cut down and set ablaze.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You who are far off, hear what I have done; you who are near, acknowledge My might.
name: The LORD

speaker: sinners-in-zion
text: Who of us can dwell with a consuming fire? Who of us can dwell with everlasting flames?
name: The sinners in Zion

speaker: god
text: Be strong, do not fear! Behold, your God will come with vengeance. With divine retribution He will come to save you.
name: The LORD

speaker: rabshakeh
text: Tell Hezekiah that this is what the great king, the king of Assyria, says: What is the basis of this confidence of yours?
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: You claim to have a strategy and strength for war, but these are empty words. In whom are you now trusting, that you have rebelled against me?
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: Look now, you are trusting in Egypt, that splintered reed of a staff that will pierce the hand of anyone who leans on it. Such is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: But if you say to me, ‘We trust in the LORD our God,’ is He not the One whose high places and altars Hezekiah has removed, saying to Judah and Jerusalem, ‘You must worship before this altar’?
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: Now, therefore, make a bargain with my master, the king of Assyria. I will give you two thousand horses—if you can put riders on them!
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: For how can you repel a single officer among the least of my master’s servants when you depend on Egypt for chariots and horsemen?
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: So now, was it apart from the LORD that I have come up against this land to destroy it? The LORD Himself said to me, ‘Go up against this land and destroy it.’
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: eliakim
text: Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, since we understand it. Do not speak to us in Hebrew in the hearing of the people on the wall.
name: Eliakim, Shebna and Joah

speaker: rabshakeh
text: Has my master sent me to speak these words only to you and your master, and not to the men sitting on the wall, who are destined with you to eat their own dung and drink their own urine?
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: This is what the king says: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, for he cannot deliver you.
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: Do not let Hezekiah persuade you to trust in the LORD when he says, ‘The LORD will surely deliver us; this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.’
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: Do not listen to Hezekiah, for this is what the king of Assyria says: Make peace with me and come out to me. Then every one of you will eat from his own vine and his own fig tree, and drink water from his own cistern,
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: until I come and take you away to a land like your own—a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: Do not let Hezekiah mislead you when he says, ‘The LORD will deliver us.’ Has the god of any nation ever delivered his land from the hand of the king of Assyria?
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Have they delivered Samaria from my hand?
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: rabshakeh
text: Who among all the gods of these lands has delivered his land from my hand? How then can the LORD deliver Jerusalem from my hand?
name: The Rabshakeh

speaker: hezekiah
text: Do not answer him.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: This is what Hezekiah says: Today is a day of distress, rebuke, and disgrace; for children have come to the point of birth, but there is no strength to deliver them.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: Perhaps the LORD your God will hear the words of the Rabshakeh, whom his master the king of Assyria has sent to defy the living God, and He will rebuke him for the words that the LORD your God has heard. Therefore lift up a prayer for the remnant that still survives.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: isaiah
text: Tell your master that this is what the LORD says: ‘Do not be afraid of the words you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed Me.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: Behold, I will put a spirit in him so that he will hear a rumor and return to his own land, where I will cause him to fall by the sword.’
name: Isaiah

speaker: unnamed-informant
text: He has set out to fight against you.
name: A report

speaker: sennacherib
text: Give this message to Hezekiah king of Judah: ‘Do not let your God, in whom you trust, deceive you by saying that Jerusalem will not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
name: Sennacherib

speaker: sennacherib
text: Surely you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the other countries, devoting them to destruction. Will you then be spared?
name: Sennacherib

speaker: sennacherib
text: Did the gods of the nations destroyed by my fathers rescue those nations—the gods of Gozan, Haran, and Rezeph, and of the people of Eden in Telassar?
name: Sennacherib

speaker: sennacherib
text: Where are the kings of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah?’
name: Sennacherib

speaker: hezekiah
text: O LORD of Hosts, God of Israel, enthroned above the cherubim, You alone are God over all the kingdoms of the earth. You made the heavens and the earth.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: Incline Your ear, O LORD, and hear; open Your eyes, O LORD, and see. Listen to all the words that Sennacherib has sent to defy the living God.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: Truly, O LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all these countries and their lands.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: They have cast their gods into the fire and destroyed them, for they were not gods, but only wood and stone—the work of human hands.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: And now, O LORD our God, save us from his hand, so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that You alone, O LORD, are God.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: isaiah
text: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Because you have prayed to Me concerning Sennacherib king of Assyria,
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: this is the word that the LORD has spoken against him: ‘The Virgin Daughter of Zion despises you and mocks you; the Daughter of Jerusalem shakes her head behind you.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: Whom have you taunted and blasphemed? Against whom have you raised your voice and lifted your eyes in pride? Against the Holy One of Israel!
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: Through your servants you have taunted the Lord, and you have said: “With my many chariots I have ascended to the heights of the mountains, to the remote peaks of Lebanon. I have cut down its tallest cedars, the finest of its cypresses. I have reached its farthest heights, the densest of its forests.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: I have dug wells and drunk foreign waters. With the soles of my feet I have dried up all the streams of Egypt.”
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: Have you not heard? Long ago I ordained it; in days of old I planned it. Now I have brought it to pass, that you should crush fortified cities into piles of rubble.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: Therefore their inhabitants, devoid of power, are dismayed and ashamed. They are like plants in the field, tender green shoots, grass on the rooftops, scorched before it is grown.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: But I know your sitting down, your going out and coming in, and your raging against Me.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: Because your rage and arrogance against Me have reached My ears, I will put My hook in your nose and My bit in your mouth; I will send you back the way you came.’
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: And this will be a sign to you, O Hezekiah: This year you will eat what grows on its own, and in the second year what springs from the same. But in the third year you will sow and reap; you will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: And the surviving remnant of the house of Judah will again take root below and bear fruit above.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: For a remnant will go forth from Jerusalem, and survivors from Mount Zion. The zeal of the LORD of Hosts will accomplish this.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: So this is what the LORD says about the king of Assyria: ‘He will not enter this city or shoot an arrow into it. He will not come before it with a shield or build up a siege ramp against it.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: He will go back the way he came, and he will not enter this city,’ declares the LORD.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: ‘I will defend this city and save it for My own sake and for the sake of My servant David.’
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: This is what the LORD says: ‘Put your house in order, for you are about to die; you will not recover.’
name: Isaiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: Please, O LORD, remember how I have walked before You faithfully and with wholehearted devotion; I have done what was good in Your sight.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: god
text: Go and tell Hezekiah that this is what the LORD, the God of your father David, says: ‘I have heard your prayer; I have seen your tears. Behold, I will add fifteen years to your life.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And I will deliver you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria. I will defend this city.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This will be a sign to you from the LORD that He will do what He has promised:
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will make the sun’s shadow that falls on the stairway of Ahaz go back ten steps.’
name: The LORD

speaker: hezekiah
text: In the prime of my life I must go through the gates of Sheol and be deprived of the remainder of my years.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: I will never again see the LORD, even the LORD, in the land of the living; I will no longer look on mankind with those who dwell in this world.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: My dwelling has been picked up and removed from me like a shepherd’s tent. I have rolled up my life like a weaver; He cuts me off from the loom; from day until night You make an end of me.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: I composed myself until the morning. Like a lion He breaks all my bones; from day until night You make an end of me.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: I chirp like a swallow or crane; I moan like a dove. My eyes grow weak as I look upward. O Lord, I am oppressed; be my security.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: isaiah
text: Prepare a lump of pressed figs and apply it to the boil, and he will recover.
name: Isaiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: What will be the sign that I will go up to the house of the LORD?
name: Hezekiah

speaker: isaiah
text: Where did those men come from, and what did they say to you?
name: Isaiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: They came to me from a distant land,
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: from Babylon.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: isaiah
text: What have they seen in your palace?
name: Isaiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: They have seen everything in my palace,
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: There is nothing among my treasures that I did not show them.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: isaiah
text: Hear the word of the LORD of Hosts:
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: The time will surely come when everything in your palace and all that your fathers have stored up until this day will be carried off to Babylon. Nothing will be left, says the LORD.
name: Isaiah

speaker: isaiah
text: And some of your descendants, your own flesh and blood, will be taken away to be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
name: Isaiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: The word of the LORD that you have spoken is good.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: hezekiah
text: At least there will be peace and security in my lifetime.
name: Hezekiah

speaker: god
text: Comfort, comfort My people,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Speak tenderly to Jerusalem, and proclaim to her that her forced labor has been completed; her iniquity has been pardoned. For she has received from the hand of the LORD double for all her sins.
name: The LORD

speaker: voice
text: Prepare the way for the LORD in the wilderness; make a straight highway for our God in the desert.
name: A voice in the wilderness

speaker: voice
text: Every valley shall be lifted up, and every mountain and hill made low; the uneven ground will become smooth, and the rugged land a plain.
name: A voice in the wilderness

speaker: voice
text: And the glory of the LORD will be revealed, and all humanity together will see it. For the mouth of the LORD has spoken.
name: A voice in the wilderness

speaker: heavenly-voice
text: Cry out!
name: A voice

speaker: isaiah
text: What should I cry out?
name: Isaiah

speaker: heavenly-voice
text: All flesh is like grass, and all its glory like the flowers of the field.
name: A voice

speaker: heavenly-voice
text: The grass withers and the flowers fall when the breath of the LORD blows on them; indeed, the people are grass.
name: A voice

speaker: heavenly-voice
text: The grass withers and the flowers fall, but the word of our God stands forever.
name: A voice

speaker: herald
text: Here is your God!
name: The herald of good news

speaker: god
text: To whom will you liken Me, or who is My equal?
name: The LORD

speaker: israelites
text: My way is hidden from the LORD, and my claim is ignored by my God
name: The people of Israel

speaker: god
text: Be silent before Me, O islands, and let the peoples renew their strength. Let them come forward and testify; let us together draw near for judgment.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Who has aroused one from the east and called him to his feet in righteousness? He hands nations over to him and subdues kings before him. He turns them to dust with his sword, to windblown chaff with his bow.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: He pursues them, going on safely, hardly touching the path with his feet.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Who has performed this and carried it out, calling forth the generations from the beginning? I, the LORD—the first and the last— I am He.
name: The LORD

speaker: idol-makers
text: Be strong!
name: The idol makers

speaker: idol-makers
text: It is good.
name: The idol makers

speaker: god
text: But you, O Israel, My servant, Jacob, whom I have chosen, descendant of Abraham My friend—
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I brought you from the ends of the earth and called you from its farthest corners. I said, ‘You are My servant.’ I have chosen and not rejected you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My right hand of righteousness.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, all who rage against you will be ashamed and disgraced; those who contend with you will be reduced to nothing and will perish.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You will seek them but will not find them. Those who wage war against you will come to nothing.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For I am the LORD your God, who takes hold of your right hand and tells you: Do not fear, I will help you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do not fear, O worm of Jacob, O few men of Israel. I will help you,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, I will make you into a threshing sledge, new and sharp, with many teeth. You will thresh the mountains and crush them, and reduce the hills to chaff.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You will winnow them, and a wind will carry them away; a gale will scatter them. But you will rejoice in the LORD; you will glory in the Holy One of Israel.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The poor and needy seek water, but there is none; their tongues are parched with thirst. I, the LORD, will answer them; I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will open rivers on the barren heights, and fountains in the middle of the valleys. I will turn the desert into a pool of water, and the dry land into flowing springs.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will plant cedars in the wilderness, acacias, myrtles, and olive trees. I will set cypresses in the desert, elms and boxwood together,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: so that all may see and know, may consider and understand, that the hand of the LORD has done this and the Holy One of Israel has created it.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Present your case,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Submit your arguments,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Let them come and tell us what will happen. Tell the former things, so that we may reflect on them and know the outcome. Or announce to us what is coming.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Tell us the things that are to come, so that we may know that you are gods. Yes, do something good or evil, that we may look on together in dismay.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, you are nothing and your work is of no value. Anyone who chooses you is detestable.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I have raised up one from the north, and he has come— one from the east who calls on My name. He will march over rulers as if they were mortar, like a potter who treads the clay.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Who has declared this from the beginning, so that we may know, and from times past, so that we may say: ‘He was right’? No one announced it, no one foretold it, no one heard your words.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I was the first to tell Zion: ‘Look, here they are!’ And I gave to Jerusalem a herald of good news.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: When I look, there is no one; there is no counselor among them; when I ask them, they have nothing to say.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: See, they are all a delusion; their works amount to nothing; their images are as empty as the wind.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Here is My Servant, whom I uphold, My Chosen One, in whom My soul delights. I will put My Spirit on Him, and He will bring justice to the nations.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: He will not cry out or raise His voice, nor make His voice heard in the streets.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: A bruised reed He will not break and a smoldering wick He will not extinguish; He will faithfully bring forth justice.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: He will not grow weak or discouraged before He has established justice on the earth. In His law the islands will put their hope.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I, the LORD, have called you for a righteous purpose, and I will take hold of your hand. I will keep you and appoint you to be a covenant for the people and a light to the nations,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: to open the eyes of the blind, to bring prisoners out of the dungeon and those sitting in darkness out from the prison house.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I am the LORD; that is My name! I will not yield My glory to another or My praise to idols.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, the former things have happened, and now I declare new things. Before they spring forth I proclaim them to you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I have kept silent from ages past; I have remained quiet and restrained. But now I will groan like a woman in labor; I will at once gasp and pant.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will lay waste the mountains and hills and dry up all their vegetation. I will turn the rivers into dry land and drain the marshes.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will lead the blind by a way they did not know; I will guide them on unfamiliar paths. I will turn darkness into light before them and rough places into level ground. These things I will do for them, and I will not forsake them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But those who trust in idols and say to molten images, ‘You are our gods!’ will be turned back in utter shame.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Listen, you deaf ones; look, you blind ones, that you may see!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Who is blind but My servant, or deaf like the messenger I am sending? Who is blind like My covenant partner, or blind like the servant of the LORD?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Though seeing many things, you do not keep watch. Though your ears are open, you do not hear.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name; you are Mine!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and when you go through the rivers, they will not overwhelm you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be scorched; the flames will not set you ablaze.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For I am the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior; I give Egypt for your ransom, Cush and Seba in your place.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Because you are precious and honored in My sight, and because I love you, I will give men in exchange for you and nations in place of your life.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do not be afraid, for I am with you; I will bring your offspring from the east and gather you from the west.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will say to the north, ‘Give them up!’ and to the south, ‘Do not hold them back!’ Bring My sons from afar, and My daughters from the ends of the earth—
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: everyone called by My name and created for My glory, whom I have indeed formed and made.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You are My witnesses,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: and My servant whom I have chosen, so that you may consider and believe Me and understand that I am He. Before Me no god was formed, and after Me none will come.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I, yes I, am the LORD, and there is no Savior but Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I alone decreed and saved and proclaimed— I, and not some foreign god among you. So you are My witnesses,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: that I am God.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Even from eternity I am He, and none can deliver out of My hand. When I act, who can reverse it?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For your sake, I will send to Babylon and bring them all as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships in which they rejoice.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I am the LORD, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, and your King.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do not call to mind the former things; pay no attention to the things of old.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, I am about to do something new; even now it is coming. Do you not see it? Indeed, I will make a way in the wilderness and streams in the desert.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The beasts of the field will honor Me, the jackals and the ostriches, because I provide water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert, to give drink to My chosen people.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The people I formed for Myself will declare My praise.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But you have not called on Me, O Jacob, because you have grown weary of Me, O Israel.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You have not brought Me sheep for burnt offerings, nor honored Me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with offerings, nor wearied you with frankincense.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You have not bought Me sweet cane with your silver, nor satisfied Me with the fat of your sacrifices. But you have burdened Me with your sins; you have wearied Me with your iniquities.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I, yes I, am He who blots out your transgressions for My own sake and remembers your sins no more.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Remind Me, let us argue the matter together. State your case, so that you may be vindicated.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Your first father sinned, and your spokesmen rebelled against Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So I will disgrace the princes of your sanctuary, and I will devote Jacob to destruction and Israel to reproach.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do not be afraid, O Jacob My servant, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For I will pour water on the thirsty land, and currents on the dry ground. I will pour out My Spirit on your descendants, and My blessing on your offspring.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They will sprout among the grass like willows by flowing streams.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: One will say, ‘I belong to the LORD,’ another will call himself by the name of Jacob, and still another will write on his hand, ‘The LORD’s,’ and will take the name of Israel.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I am the first and I am the last, and there is no God but Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Who then is like Me? Let him say so! Let him declare his case before Me, since I established an ancient people. Let him foretell the things to come, and what is to take place.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do not tremble or fear. Have I not told you and declared it long ago? You are My witnesses! Is there any God but Me? There is no other Rock; I know not one.
name: The LORD

speaker: idolater
text: Ah! I am warm; I see the fire.
name: The idolater

speaker: idolater
text: Save me, for you are my god.
name: The idolater

speaker: idolater
text: I burned half of it in the fire, and I baked bread on its coals; I roasted meat and I ate. Shall I make something detestable with the rest of it? Shall I bow down to a block of wood?
name: The idolater

speaker: idolater
text: Is not this thing in my right hand a lie?
name: The idolater

speaker: god
text: I am the LORD, who has made all things, who alone stretched out the heavens, who by Myself spread out the earth,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: who foils the signs of false prophets and makes fools of diviners, who confounds the wise and turns their knowledge into nonsense,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: who confirms the message of His servant and fulfills the counsel of His messengers, who says of Jerusalem, ‘She will be inhabited,’ and of the cities of Judah, ‘They will be rebuilt, and I will restore their ruins,’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: who says to the depths of the sea, ‘Be dry, and I will dry up your currents,’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: who says of Cyrus, ‘My shepherd will fulfill all that I desire,’ who says of Jerusalem, ‘She will be rebuilt,’ and of the temple, ‘Let its foundation be laid.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will go before you and level the mountains; I will break down the gates of bronze and cut through the bars of iron.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will give you the treasures of darkness and the riches hidden in secret places, so that you may know that I am the LORD, the God of Israel, who calls you by name.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For the sake of Jacob My servant and Israel My chosen one, I call you by name; I have given you a title of honor, though you have not known Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I am the LORD, and there is no other; there is no God but Me. I will equip you for battle, though you have not known Me,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: so that all may know, from where the sun rises to where it sets, that there is none but Me; I am the LORD, and there is no other.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I form the light and create the darkness; I bring prosperity and create calamity. I, the LORD, do all these things.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Drip down, O heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness. Let the earth open up that salvation may sprout and righteousness spring up with it; I, the LORD, have created it.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Woe to him who quarrels with his Maker— one clay pot among many. Does the clay ask the potter, ‘What are you making?’ Does your work say, ‘He has no hands’?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Woe to him who says to his father, ‘What have you begotten?’ or to his mother, ‘What have you brought forth?’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: How dare you question Me about My sons, or instruct Me in the work of My hands?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: It is I who made the earth and created man upon it. It was My hands that stretched out the heavens, and I ordained all their host.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will raise up Cyrus in righteousness, and I will make all his ways straight. He will rebuild My city and set My exiles free, but not for payment or reward, says the LORD of Hosts.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The products of Egypt and the merchandise of Cush, along with the Sabeans, men of stature, will come over to you and will be yours; they will trudge behind you; they will come over in chains and bow down to you. They will confess to you: ‘God is indeed with you, and there is no other; there is no other God.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I am the LORD, and there is no other.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I have not spoken in secret, from a place in a land of darkness. I did not say to the descendants of Jacob, ‘Seek Me in a wasteland.’ I, the LORD, speak the truth; I say what is right.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Come, gather together, and draw near, you fugitives from the nations. Ignorant are those who carry idols of wood and pray to a god that cannot save.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Speak up and present your case— yes, let them take counsel together. Who foretold this long ago? Who announced it from ancient times? Was it not I, the LORD? There is no other God but Me, a righteous God and Savior; there is none but Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Turn to Me and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: By Myself I have sworn; truth has gone out from My mouth, a word that will not be revoked: Every knee will bow before Me, every tongue will swear allegiance.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Surely they will say of Me, ‘In the LORD alone are righteousness and strength.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Listen to Me, O house of Jacob, all the remnant of the house of Israel, who have been sustained from the womb, carried along since birth.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Even to your old age, I will be the same, and I will bear you up when you turn gray. I have made you, and I will carry you; I will sustain you and deliver you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: To whom will you liken Me or count Me equal? To whom will you compare Me, that we should be alike?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They pour out their bags of gold and weigh out silver on scales; they hire a goldsmith to fashion it into a god, so they can bow down and worship.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They lift it to their shoulder and carry it along; they set it in its place, and there it stands, not budging from that spot. They cry out to it, but it does not answer; it saves no one from his troubles.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Remember this and be brave; take it to heart, you transgressors!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Remember what happened long ago, for I am God, and there is no other; I am God, and there is none like Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I declare the end from the beginning, and ancient times from what is still to come. I say, ‘My purpose will stand, and all My good pleasure I will accomplish.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I summon a bird of prey from the east, a man for My purpose from a far-off land. Truly I have spoken, and truly I will bring it to pass. I have planned it, and I will surely do it.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Listen to Me, you stubborn people, far removed from righteousness:
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I am bringing My righteousness near; it is not far away, and My salvation will not be delayed. I will grant salvation to Zion and adorn Israel with My splendor.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Go down and sit in the dust, O Virgin Daughter of Babylon. Sit on the ground without a throne, O Daughter of Chaldea! For you will no longer be called tender or delicate.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Take millstones and grind flour; remove your veil; strip off your skirt, bare your thigh, and wade through the streams.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Your nakedness will be uncovered and your shame will be exposed. I will take vengeance; I will spare no one.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Sit in silence and go into darkness, O Daughter of Chaldea. For you will no longer be called the queen of kingdoms.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I was angry with My people; I profaned My heritage, and I placed them under your control. You showed them no mercy; even on the elderly you laid a most heavy yoke.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You said, ‘I will be queen forever.’ You did not take these things to heart or consider their outcome.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So now hear this, O lover of luxury who sits securely, who says to herself, ‘I am, and there is none besides me. I will never be a widow or know the loss of children.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: These two things will overtake you in a moment, in a single day: loss of children, and widowhood. They will come upon you in full measure, in spite of your many sorceries and the potency of your spells.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You were secure in your wickedness; you said, ‘No one sees me.’ Your wisdom and knowledge led you astray; you told yourself, ‘I am, and there is none besides me.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But disaster will come upon you; you will not know how to charm it away. A calamity will befall you that you will be unable to ward off. Devastation will happen to you suddenly and unexpectedly.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So take your stand with your spells and with your many sorceries, with which you have wearied yourself from your youth. Perhaps you will succeed; perhaps you will inspire terror!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You are wearied by your many counselors; let them come forward now and save you— your astrologers who observe the stars, who monthly predict your fate.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Surely they are like stubble; the fire will burn them up. They cannot deliver themselves from the power of the flame. There will be no coals to warm them or fire to sit beside.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This is what they are to you— those with whom you have labored and traded from youth— each one strays in his own direction; not one of them can save you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Listen to this, O house of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel, who have descended from the line of Judah, who swear by the name of the LORD, who invoke the God of Israel— but not in truth or righteousness—
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: who indeed call yourselves after the holy city and lean on the God of Israel; the LORD of Hosts is His name.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I foretold the former things long ago; they came out of My mouth and I proclaimed them. Suddenly I acted, and they came to pass.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For I knew that you are stubborn; your neck is iron and your forehead is bronze.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore I declared it to you long ago; I announced it before it came to pass, so that you could not claim, ‘My idol has done this; my carved image and molten god has ordained it.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You have heard these things; look at them all. Will you not acknowledge them? From now on I will tell you of new things, hidden things unknown to you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They are created now, and not long ago; you have not heard of them before today. So you cannot claim, ‘I already knew them!’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You have never heard; you have never understood; for a long time your ears have not been open. For I knew how deceitful you are; you have been called a rebel from birth.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For the sake of My name I will delay My wrath; for the sake of My praise I will restrain it, so that you will not be cut off.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: See, I have refined you, but not as silver; I have tested you in the furnace of affliction.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For My own sake, My very own sake, I will act; for how can I let Myself be defamed? I will not yield My glory to another.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Listen to Me, O Jacob, and Israel, whom I have called: I am He; I am the first, and I am the last.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Surely My own hand founded the earth, and My right hand spread out the heavens; when I summon them, they stand up together.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Come together, all of you, and listen: Which of the idols has foretold these things? The LORD’s chosen ally will carry out His desire against Babylon, and His arm will be against the Chaldeans.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I, even I, have spoken; yes, I have called him. I have brought him, and he will succeed in his mission.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Come near to Me and listen to this: From the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time it happened, I was there.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I am the LORD your God, who teaches you for your benefit, who directs you in the way you should go.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: If only you had paid attention to My commandments, your peace would have been like a river, and your righteousness like waves of the sea.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Your descendants would have been as countless as the sand, and your offspring as numerous as its grains; their name would never be cut off or eliminated from My presence.
name: The LORD

speaker: worshipers
text: The LORD has redeemed His servant Jacob!
name: The redeemed

speaker: god
text: There is no peace,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: for the wicked.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You are My Servant, Israel, in whom I will display My glory.
name: The LORD

speaker: servant
text: I have labored in vain, I have spent My strength in futility and vanity; yet My vindication is with the LORD, and My reward is with My God.
name: The Servant of the LORD

speaker: god
text: It is not enough for You to be My Servant, to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the protected ones of Israel. I will also make You a light for the nations, to bring My salvation to the ends of the earth.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Kings will see You and rise, and princes will bow down, because of the LORD, who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen You.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In the time of favor I will answer You, and in the day of salvation I will help You; I will keep You and appoint You to be a covenant for the people, to restore the land, to apportion its desolate inheritances,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: to say to the prisoners, ‘Come out,’ and to those in darkness, ‘Show yourselves.’ They will feed along the pathways, and find pasture on every barren hill.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They will not hunger or thirst, nor will scorching heat or sun beat down on them. For He who has compassion on them will guide them and lead them beside springs of water.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will turn all My mountains into roads, and My highways will be raised up.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, they will come from far away, from the north and from the west, and from the land of Aswan.
name: The LORD

speaker: zion
text: The LORD has forsaken me; the Lord has forgotten me!
name: Zion

speaker: god
text: Can a woman forget her nursing child, or lack compassion for the son of her womb? Even if she could forget, I will not forget you!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, I have inscribed you on the palms of My hands; your walls are ever before Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Your builders hasten back; your destroyers and wreckers depart from you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Lift up your eyes and look around. They all gather together; they come to you. As surely as I live,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: you will wear them all as jewelry and put them on like a bride.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For your ruined and desolate places and your ravaged land will now indeed be too small for your people, and those who devoured you will be far away.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yet the children of your bereavement will say in your hearing, ‘This place is too small for us; make room for us to live here.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then you will say in your heart, ‘Who has begotten these for me? I was bereaved and barren; I was exiled and rejected. So who has reared them? Look, I was left all alone, so where did they come from?’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, I will lift up My hand to the nations, and raise My banner to the peoples. They will bring your sons in their arms and carry your daughters on their shoulders.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Kings will be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow to you facedown and lick the dust at your feet. Then you will know that I am the LORD; those who hope in Me will never be put to shame.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Even the captives of the mighty will be taken away, and the plunder of the tyrant will be retrieved; I will contend with those who contend with you, and I will save your children.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will make your oppressors eat their own flesh; they will be drunk on their own blood, as with wine. Then all mankind will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Where is your mother’s certificate of divorce with which I sent her away? Or to which of My creditors did I sell you? Look, you were sold for your iniquities, and for your transgressions your mother was sent away.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Why was no one there when I arrived? Why did no one answer when I called? Is My hand too short to redeem you? Or do I lack the strength to deliver you? Behold, My rebuke dries up the sea; I turn the rivers into a desert; the fish rot for lack of water and die of thirst.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I clothe the heavens in black and make sackcloth their covering.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Listen to Me, you who pursue righteousness, you who seek the LORD: Look to the rock from which you were cut, and to the quarry from which you were hewn.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Look to Abraham your father, and to Sarah who gave you birth. When I called him, he was but one; then I blessed him and multiplied him.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For the LORD will comfort Zion and will look with compassion on all her ruins; He will make her wilderness like Eden and her desert like the garden of the LORD. Joy and gladness will be found in her, thanksgiving and melodious song.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Pay attention to Me, My people, and listen to Me, My nation; for a law will go out from Me, and My justice will become a light to the nations; I will bring it about quickly.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: My righteousness draws near, My salvation is on the way, and My arms will bring justice to the nations. The islands will look for Me and wait in hope for My arm.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look at the earth below; for the heavens will vanish like smoke, the earth will wear out like a garment, and its people will die like gnats. But My salvation will last forever, and My righteousness will never fail.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Listen to Me, you who know what is right, you people with My law in your hearts: Do not fear the scorn of men; do not be broken by their insults.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For the moth will devour them like a garment, and the worm will eat them like wool. But My righteousness will last forever, My salvation through all generations.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I, even I, am He who comforts you. Why should you be afraid of mortal man, of a son of man who withers like grass?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But you have forgotten the LORD, your Maker, who stretched out the heavens and laid the foundations of the earth. You live in terror all day long because of the fury of the oppressor who is bent on destruction. But where is the fury of the oppressor?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The captive will soon be freed; he will not die in the dungeon, and his bread will not be lacking.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For I am the LORD your God who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar— the LORD of Hosts is His name.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I have put My words in your mouth, and covered you with the shadow of My hand, to establish the heavens, to found the earth, and to say to Zion, ‘You are My people.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: See, I have removed from your hand the cup of staggering. From that goblet, the cup of My fury, you will never drink again.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will place it in the hands of your tormentors, who told you: ‘Lie down, so we can walk over you,’ so that you made your back like the ground, like a street to be traversed.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You were sold for nothing, and without money you will be redeemed.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: At first My people went down to Egypt to live, then Assyria oppressed them without cause.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And now what have I here? declares the LORD. For My people have been taken without cause; those who rule them taunt, declares the LORD, and My name is blasphemed continually all day long.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore My people will know My name; therefore they will know on that day that I am He who speaks. Here I am!
name: The LORD

speaker: herald
text: Your God reigns!
name: The herald of good news

speaker: god
text: Shout for joy, O barren woman, who bears no children; break forth in song and cry aloud, you who have never travailed; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Enlarge the site of your tent, stretch out the curtains of your dwellings, do not hold back. Lengthen your ropes and drive your stakes in deep.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For you will spread out to the right and left; your descendants will dispossess the nations and inhabit the desolate cities.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do not be afraid, for you will not be put to shame; do not be intimidated, for you will not be humiliated. For you will forget the shame of your youth and will remember no more the reproach of your widowhood.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For your husband is your Maker— the LORD of Hosts is His name— the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer; He is called the God of all the earth.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For the LORD has called you back, like a wife deserted and wounded in spirit, like the rejected wife of one’s youth,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For a brief moment I forsook you, but with great compassion I will bring you back.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In a surge of anger I hid My face from you for a moment, but with everlasting kindness I will have compassion on you,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For to Me this is like the days of Noah, when I swore that the waters of Noah would never again cover the earth. So I have sworn that I will not be angry with you or rebuke you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Though the mountains may be removed and the hills may be shaken, My loving devotion will not depart from you, and My covenant of peace will not be broken,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: O afflicted city, lashed by storms, without solace, surely I will set your stones in antimony and lay your foundations with sapphires.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will make your pinnacles of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then all your sons will be taught by the LORD, and great will be their prosperity.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In righteousness you will be established, far from oppression, for you will have no fear. Terror will be far removed, for it will not come near you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: If anyone attacks you, it is not from Me; whoever assails you will fall before you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, I have created the craftsman who fans the coals into flame and forges a weapon fit for its task; and I have created the destroyer to wreak havoc.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: No weapon formed against you shall prosper, and you will refute every tongue that accuses you. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their vindication is from Me,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Come, all you who are thirsty, come to the waters; and you without money, come, buy, and eat! Come, buy wine and milk without money and without cost!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Why spend money on that which is not bread, and your labor on that which does not satisfy? Listen carefully to Me, and eat what is good, and your soul will delight in the richest of foods.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Incline your ear and come to Me; listen, so that your soul may live. I will make with you an everlasting covenant— My loving devotion promised to David.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, I have made him a witness to the nations, a leader and commander of the peoples.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Surely you will summon a nation you do not know, and nations who do not know you will run to you. For the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, has bestowed glory on you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For My thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways My ways,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so My ways are higher than your ways and My thoughts than your thoughts.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For just as rain and snow fall from heaven and do not return without watering the earth, making it bud and sprout, and providing seed to sow and food to eat,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: so My word that proceeds from My mouth will not return to Me empty, but it will accomplish what I please, and it will prosper where I send it.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You will indeed go out with joy and be led forth in peace; the mountains and hills will burst into song before you, and all the trees of the field will clap their hands.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Instead of the thornbush, a cypress will grow, and instead of the brier, a myrtle will spring up; they will make a name for the LORD, an everlasting sign, never to be destroyed.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Maintain justice and do what is right, for My salvation is coming soon, and My righteousness will be revealed.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Blessed is the man who does this, and the son of man who holds it fast, who keeps the Sabbath without profaning it and keeps his hand from doing any evil.
name: The LORD

speaker: foreigner
text: The LORD will utterly exclude me from His people.
name: The foreigner

speaker: eunuch
text: I am but a dry tree.
name: The eunuch

speaker: god
text: To the eunuchs who keep My Sabbaths, who choose what pleases Me and hold fast to My covenant—
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will give them, in My house and within My walls, a memorial and a name better than that of sons and daughters. I will give them an everlasting name that will not be cut off.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And the foreigners who join themselves to the LORD to minister to Him, to love the name of the LORD, and to be His servants— all who keep the Sabbath without profaning it and who hold fast to My covenant—
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will bring them to My holy mountain and make them joyful in My house of prayer. Their burnt offerings and sacrifices will be accepted on My altar, for My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will gather to them still others besides those already gathered.
name: The LORD

speaker: shepherds
text: Come, let me get the wine, let us imbibe the strong drink, and tomorrow will be like today, only far better!
name: The worthless shepherds

speaker: god
text: But come here, you sons of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
