text: Whom are you mocking? At whom do you snarl and stick out your tongue? Are you not children of transgression, offspring of deceit,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: who burn with lust among the oaks, under every luxuriant tree, who slaughter your children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Your portion is among the smooth stones of the valley; indeed, they are your lot. Even to them you have poured out a drink offering and offered a grain offering. Should I relent because of these?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: On a high and lofty hill you have made your bed, and there you went up to offer sacrifices.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behind the door and doorpost you have set up your memorial. Forsaking Me, you uncovered your bed; you climbed up and opened it wide. And you have made a pact with those whose bed you have loved; you have gazed upon their nakedness.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You went to Molech with oil and multiplied your perfumes. You have sent your envoys a great distance; you have descended even to Sheol itself.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You are wearied by your many journeys, but you did not say, “There is no hope!” You found renewal of your strength; therefore you did not grow weak.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Whom have you dreaded and feared, so that you lied and failed to remember Me or take this to heart? Is it not because I have long been silent that you do not fear Me?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will expose your righteousness and your works, and they will not profit you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: When you cry out, let your companies of idols deliver you! Yet the wind will carry off all of them, a breath will take them away. But he who seeks refuge in Me will inherit the land and possess My holy mountain.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I dwell in a high and holy place, and with the oppressed and humble in spirit, to restore the spirit of the lowly and revive the heart of the contrite.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For I will not accuse you forever, nor will I always be angry; for then the spirit of man would grow weak before Me, with the breath of those I have made.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I was enraged by his sinful greed, so I struck him and hid My face in anger; yet he kept turning back to the desires of his heart.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I have seen his ways, but I will heal him; I will guide him and restore comfort to him and his mourners,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: bringing praise to their lips. Peace, peace to those far and near,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: and I will heal them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: There is no peace,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: for the wicked.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Cry aloud, do not hold back! Raise your voice like a ram’s horn. Declare to My people their transgression and to the house of Jacob their sins.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For day after day they seek Me and delight to know My ways, like a nation that does what is right and does not forsake the justice of their God. They ask Me for righteous judgments; they delight in the nearness of God.
name: The LORD

speaker: israelites
text: Why have we fasted, and You have not seen? Why have we humbled ourselves, and You have not noticed?
name: The people of Israel

speaker: god
text: Behold, on the day of your fast, you do as you please, and you oppress all your workers.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You fast with contention and strife to strike viciously with your fist. You cannot fast as you do today and have your voice be heard on high.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Is this the fast I have chosen: a day for a man to deny himself, to bow his head like a reed, and to spread out sackcloth and ashes? Will you call this a fast and a day acceptable to the LORD?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Isn’t this the fast that I have chosen: to break the chains of wickedness, to untie the cords of the yoke, to set the oppressed free and tear off every yoke?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Isn’t it to share your bread with the hungry, to bring the poor and homeless into your home, to clothe the naked when you see him, and not to turn away from your own flesh and blood?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then your light will break forth like the dawn, and your healing will come quickly. Your righteousness will go before you, and the glory of the LORD will be your rear guard.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then you will call, and the LORD will answer; you will cry out, and He will say, ‘Here I am.’ If you remove the yoke from your midst, the pointing of the finger and malicious talk,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: and if you give yourself to the hungry and satisfy the afflicted soul, then your light will go forth in the darkness, and your night will be like noonday.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The LORD will always guide you; He will satisfy you in a sun-scorched land and strengthen your frame. You will be like a well-watered garden, like a spring whose waters never fail.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Your people will rebuild the ancient ruins; you will restore the age-old foundations; you will be called Repairer of the Breach, Restorer of the Streets of Dwelling.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: If you turn your foot from breaking the Sabbath, from doing as you please on My holy day, if you call the Sabbath a delight, and the LORD’s holy day honorable, if you honor it by not going your own way or seeking your own pleasure or speaking idle words,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: then you will delight yourself in the LORD, and I will make you ride on the heights of the land and feed you with the heritage of your father Jacob.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The Redeemer will come to Zion, to those in Jacob who turn from transgression,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: As for Me, this is My covenant with them,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: My Spirit will not depart from you, and My words that I have put in your mouth will not depart from your mouth or from the mouths of your children and grandchildren, from now on and forevermore,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Never again will I give your grain to your enemies for food, nor will foreigners drink the new wine for which you have toiled.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For those who harvest grain will eat it and praise the LORD, and those who gather grapes will drink the wine in My holy courts.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Say to Daughter Zion: See, your Savior comes! Look, His reward is with Him, and His recompense goes before Him.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: It is I, proclaiming vindication, mighty to save.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I have trodden the winepress alone, and no one from the nations was with Me. I trampled them in My anger and trod them down in My fury; their blood spattered My garments, and all My clothes were stained.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For the day of vengeance was in My heart, and the year of My redemption had come.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I looked, but there was no one to help; I was appalled that no one assisted. So My arm brought Me salvation, and My own wrath upheld Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I trampled the nations in My anger; in My wrath I made them drunk and poured out their blood on the ground.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They are surely My people, sons who will not be disloyal.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I revealed Myself to those who did not ask for Me; I was found by those who did not seek Me. To a nation that did not call My name, I said, ‘Here I am! Here I am!’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: All day long I have held out My hands to an obstinate people who walk in the wrong path, who follow their own imaginations,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: to a people who continually provoke Me to My face, sacrificing in the gardens and burning incense on altars of brick,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: sitting among the graves, spending nights in secret places, eating the meat of pigs and polluted broth from their bowls.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They say, ‘Keep to yourself; do not come near me, for I am holier than you!’ Such people are smoke in My nostrils, a fire that burns all day long.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, it is written before Me: I will not keep silent, but I will repay; I will pay it back into their laps,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: both for your iniquities and for those of your fathers,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Because they burned incense on the mountains and scorned Me on the hills, I will measure into their laps full payment for their former deeds.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: As the new wine is found in a cluster of grapes, and men say, ‘Do not destroy it, for it contains a blessing,’ so I will act on behalf of My servants; I will not destroy them all.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And I will bring forth descendants from Jacob, and heirs from Judah; My elect will possess My mountains, and My servants will dwell there.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Sharon will become a pasture for flocks, and the Valley of Achor a resting place for herds, for My people who seek Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But you who forsake the LORD, who forget My holy mountain, who set a table for Fortune and fill bowls of mixed wine for Destiny,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will destine you for the sword, and you will all kneel down to be slaughtered, because I called and you did not answer, I spoke and you did not listen; you did evil in My sight and chose that in which I did not delight.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: My servants will eat, but you will go hungry; My servants will drink, but you will go thirsty; My servants will rejoice, but you will be put to shame.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: My servants will shout for joy with a glad heart, but you will cry out with a heavy heart and wail with a broken spirit.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You will leave behind your name as a curse for My chosen ones, and the Lord GOD will slay you; but to His servants He will give another name.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Whoever invokes a blessing in the land will do so by the God of truth, and whoever takes an oath in the land will swear by the God of truth. For the former troubles will be forgotten and hidden from My sight.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For behold, I will create new heavens and a new earth. The former things will not be remembered, nor will they come to mind.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But be glad and rejoice forever in what I create; for I will create Jerusalem to be a joy and its people to be a delight.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will rejoice in Jerusalem and take delight in My people. The sounds of weeping and crying will no longer be heard in her.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: No longer will a nursing infant live but a few days, or an old man fail to live out his years. For the youth will die at a hundred years, and he who fails to reach a hundred will be considered accursed.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They will build houses and dwell in them; they will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: No longer will they build houses for others to inhabit, nor plant for others to eat. For as is the lifetime of a tree, so will be the days of My people, and My chosen ones will fully enjoy the work of their hands.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They will not labor in vain or bear children doomed to disaster; for they will be a people blessed by the LORD— they and their descendants with them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Even before they call, I will answer, and while they are still speaking, I will hear.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The wolf and the lamb will feed together, and the lion will eat straw like the ox, but the food of the serpent will be dust. They will neither harm nor destroy on all My holy mountain,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Heaven is My throne, and earth is My footstool. What kind of house will you build for Me? Or where will My place of repose be?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Has not My hand made all these things? And so they came into being,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This is the one I will esteem: he who is humble and contrite in spirit, who trembles at My word.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Whoever slaughters an ox is like one who slays a man; whoever sacrifices a lamb is like one who breaks a dog’s neck; whoever presents a grain offering is like one who offers pig’s blood; whoever offers frankincense is like one who blesses an idol. Indeed, they have chosen their own ways and delighted in their abominations.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So I will choose their punishment and I will bring terror upon them, because I called and no one answered, I spoke and no one listened. But they did evil in My sight and chose that in which I did not delight.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Your brothers who hate you and exclude you because of My name have said, ‘Let the LORD be glorified that we may see your joy!’ But they will be put to shame.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Before she was in labor, she gave birth; before she was in pain, she delivered a boy.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Who has heard of such as this? Who has seen such things? Can a country be born in a day or a nation be delivered in an instant? Yet as soon as Zion was in labor, she gave birth to her children.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Shall I bring a baby to the point of birth and not deliver it?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Or will I who deliver close the womb?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will extend peace to her like a river, and the wealth of nations like a flowing stream; you will nurse and be carried on her arm, and bounced upon her knees.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: As a mother comforts her son, so will I comfort you, and you will be consoled over Jerusalem.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Those who consecrate and purify themselves to enter the groves—to follow one in the center of those who eat the flesh of swine and vermin and rats—will perish together,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And I, knowing their deeds and thoughts, am coming to gather all nations and tongues, and they will come and see My glory.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will establish a sign among them, and I will send survivors from among them to the nations—to Tarshish, Put, and the archers of Lud; to Tubal, Javan, and the islands far away who have not heard of My fame or seen My glory. So they will proclaim My glory among the nations.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And they will bring all your brothers from all the nations as a gift to the LORD on horses and chariots and wagons, on mules and camels, to My holy mountain Jerusalem,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: just as the Israelites bring an offering in a clean vessel to the house of the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And I will select some of them as priests and Levites,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For just as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, will endure before Me,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: so your descendants and your name will endure.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: From one New Moon to another and from one Sabbath to another, all mankind will come to worship before Me,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: As they go forth, they will see the corpses of the men who have rebelled against Me; for their worm will never die, their fire will never be quenched, and they will be a horror to all mankind.
name: The LORD
